format: New freestanding Del Taco restaurant (Fresh Flex prototype, 1,152 to 2,304 sq ft), single Franchise Agreement, excluding land and financing

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Del Taco franchised business ranges from $1,497,200 to $3,321,000. This includes between $46,700 to $156,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate(s).

fee.quote: If you purchase the rights to develop and operate one Del Taco Restaurant under a Franchise Agreement, you must pay us a Franchise Fee of $35,000 and a Promotional Fee of $10,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Plus a $10,000 Promotional Fee that must be spent (with Del Taco's approval) promoting your restaurant within one year of opening, or forfeited. Veterans Program: fee reduced 25% to $26,250 for a qualifying veteran's first new restaurant. Nontraditional locations: $1,750 per year of the term. Development Agreement: $35,000 for the first restaurant plus $10,000 deposit for each additional (balance $25,000 each). Pre-opening technical support reimbursement $1,700 to $3,500; site development services fee up to $50,000 if Del Taco provides them.

royalty.quote: Royalty 2 5% of net sales Payable monthly by electronic funds transfer by the fifteenth (15th) day of each month, based on the Net Sales for the preceding month

adFund.quote: Marketing 4% of net sales ... We may increase the fee to the then-current fee we charge new franchisees upon notice to you. The marketing fee for nontraditional locations is typically 1.4% of net sales, but we may modify this fee.
adFund.note: 4% of net sales; may be raised to the then-current rate for new franchisees; nontraditional locations typically 1.4%.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Systems Support Services Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $173.81 per restaurant per month for your 1st through 5th restaurants; $148.82 per restaurant per month for your 6th through 10th restaurants; $123.84 per restaurant per month for your 11th restaurant and beyond

otherRecurring.name: Ceridian Dayforce (workforce management)
otherRecurring.amount: $109.75 per month, $577.50 per year annual, $2,997.50 one-time payment for Ceridian clock

otherRecurring.name: Royalty for Games and Devices
otherRecurring.amount: 40% of net sales from such games and devices, monthly

transferFee.amount: $5,000 Prior to our consent for the transfer

item19.quote: Number of Restaurants (open at least 12 months) 387 ... Average Sales $1,613,899 ... Number/Percentage of Restaurants Greater than Average 176/45% ... Median Sales $1,541,335
item19.note: Franchised figures are sales only. Profit figures are for company-owned freestanding restaurants (105 of 116 in California), before rent, real estate taxes, royalty (company restaurants pay none; imputed 5% royalty is $90,208), overhead, depreciation, interest and income taxes. Operating profit 21.2% minus 5% royalty is not printed as a figure.

special: A $10,000 Promotional Fee is paid to Del Taco at signing but must be spent on promoting your own restaurant (unused portion forfeited). Item 19 profit margin is company-owned, before rent and before the 5% royalty franchisees pay. Del Taco refranchised many company restaurants in 2023-2024 (111 and 47 sold to franchisees), which drives the franchised unit growth. Development Incentive Program (selected emerging markets only) reduces royalty to 1%/2%/3%/4% in years 1-4.
issues: This is the 2025 FDD (issued May 5, 2025; fiscal year ended September 29, 2024); no 2026 FDD in the source. Cover says $46,700 to $156,000 paid to franchisor, but Item 7 fees to Del Taco sum to $46,700-$56,000 (possibly plus the up-to-$50,000 site development fee); the $156,000 high is not reconciled in Items 5/7.
